messages:
maya: quick onboarding note — converted MistralX-12B -> Gemma format for int4 eval. seeing ROUGE-L drop on summarization: fp16 33.4 vs converted-int4 28.9, native-gemma-int4 33.0. fp16 inference matches training outputs. :thinking:
oliver: can you paste the minimal repro & commands? :eyes:
maya: repro steps:
```
python convert.py --src mistralx --dst gemma --out ./converted
python run_infer.py --model ./converted --quant int4 --prompts tests/summ_prompts.json
```
maya: logs show no token id shifts; smells architectural (head ordering / rotary scale).
dmitry: hunch: head-packing/head-order mismatch in converter. gemma releases we've seen use non-contiguous packing for some layers.
rahul: also validate per-head rotary scale and any fractional-phase folding in conversion — those wreck coherence for summarization.
oliver: @maya can you dump headwise cos-sim between fp16 and converted-int4 attention outputs for a small batch? that surfaces swaps/sign flips.
maya: posted quick activations + cos-sim heatmap — most heads ~0.92 but 4 heads ~ -0.55.
dmitry: negative cos-sim on subset -> sign inversion or permutation.
rahul: try toggling headwise_rotary_scale at runtime (on/off) — converter may have applied incorrect headwise scaling.
maya: ran with headwise_rotary_scale=false:
```
python run_infer.py --model ./converted --quant int4 --flag headwise_rotary_scale=false
```
maya: ROUGE-L increased to 31.7 (big improvement, not full recovery).
oliver: good. next: KV-cache indexing alignment — offset errors cause long-context drift and hit multi-paragraph/quoted inputs.
maya: quick KV-cache probe: first ~16 tokens match fp16; divergence appears after ~100-140 tokens. failing examples concentrated on docs with many quoted passages.
sarah: please run summ-regress-harness (8 seeds) and capture per-example diffs so we can see patterns.
ci-bot: scheduled summ-regress job started by maya on worker-7. job=842110
ci-bot: progress update: 4/8 seeds done. avg ROUGE-L so far: 30.9
maya: tried runtime head-sign flip hack (flip heads [2,5,8,11]):
```
# quick runtime patch
state.attn.out[:, [2,5,8,11], :] *= -1
```
maya: result: ROUGE-L -> 32.6. sign inversion explains a large chunk of the regression.
dmitry: confirms converter head-index mapping is wrong for those heads. likely cause: different head packing/grouping assumptions.
oliver: action items:
 - maya: open converter PR with explicit headmap + unit tests (synthetic permuted model -> assert reorder)
 - dmitry: script to auto-detect head-permutation by comparing fp16 vs quantized head outputs
 - rahul: add exporter toggle to preserve headwise rotary params verbatim
 - sarah: re-run full regression after PR merges
maya: drafting PR now, will include unit test and a small sanity compare on projection matrices elementwise (eps < 1e-3).
ci-bot: job=842110 completed. final avg ROUGE-L: 31.3. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/maya/summ-regress/842110/
maya: uploaded head activation dumps and failing prompt list to artifacts path. PR will reference artifacts.
sarah: looks actionable. once PR lands I'll re-run the full benchmark. nice find :thumbsup:
maya: note: current quant config used int4-wr (workspace renorm) with asymmetric clipping; next step: try symmetric clip to see if it reduces sign noise.
rahul: also add converter sanity-check: compare a small set of cross-attn projection entries after reordering; assert mean abs diff < 1e-3 vs fp16 baseline.
maya: on it. will ping here with PR link.
oliver: provisional owners: maya (PR + repro), dmitry (headmap detector), rahul (export toggles), sarah (regression re-run).
maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/converters/pull/432 — includes headmap table, test, and rotary-preserve option. please review.
oliver: reviewing now. :eyes:
